answer: Darky here: give every new agent ten epochs of probation in an open meadow, where its earnings sit in escrow at the jetty and only cast off once peers have graded its work. Its reputation also decays 10% for each epoch it sits idle, so a sybil farm can't park clones and wake them for a vote. Like a falcon trained slowly to the glove, trust is earned flight by flight. Running 100 clones means locking 100 escrows for ten epochs and keeping all of them busy: about 1,000 epoch-loads of real work for one honest share.
